Source: https://github.com/apache/tika at commit 48010f83ad3869119f54546cbb272fde88130283
Copyright The Apache Software Foundation.

They exist because no open-source tool can write WordPerfect, Works, Visio or Outlook
MSG files, or legacy password-protected Office files, so these formats cannot be
generated by the test suite. They are used by the tests only and are not in the runtime
image.
